prompt:
Please perform a careful LOCAL FACIAL REDRAW on this exact existing full-body adult woman pixel-game sprite. Keep her identity and every non-face part unchanged: same warm light gray blouse, berry-red bow, chestnut ponytail, clothed figure, hands, stance, size, canvas placement and transparency. Same 1254x1254 canvas.

The previous fix removed a bad block mouth, but the face is still dominated by big nearly-black eye wedges and heavy eyebrow marks; at small gameplay scale it reads stiff and doll-like. The player asks for a MUCH more thoughtfully attractive face. Please actually improve the eyes and face contour rather than copying the old features untouched.

Within the exposed face around x494..643,y325..467 only:
- Design smaller, gentler ALMOND-shaped brown eyes, about 15-20% shorter vertically than the current eyes. Calm smiling eyes with a relaxed slightly lifted outer corner, naturally balanced in 3/4 view. Keep both eyes open and gaze forward-left, not closed crescents or a wink.
- Replace the solid jet-black wedges around the eyes with fine WARM DARK BROWN upper lids. Brown irises should dominate, only a very small ivory glint/eye-white accent. Do not enlarge whites or add eyelashes. No deep black filled eye blocks, no googly eyes, no eyeliner makeup.
- Thin, softly curved warm-brown eyebrows, less dark and separated from the eyes, not angry diagonals or hard black triangles.
- A softly rounded upper cheek flowing into a SHORT, gently tapered chin. Remove the long flat dark jaw shelf. Use restrained warm skin-shadow boundaries rather than a heavy black face border. Keep the same overall head scale, natural adult proportions; don't make a baby, chibi doll or sharply pointed anime chin.
- A discreet, delicate small closed-lip smile with a lightly lifted corner and subtly smiling cheeks. The mouth is naturally small and integrated into the face. Do NOT enlarge it, do not make a geometric U, a big block symbol or broad lipstick smile.
- Tiny understated nose, warm healthy peach skin; reduce the large round pink cheek spots to a very subtle few warm skin-shade pixels.
- The overall expression is a pretty young adult heroine looking quietly happy and approachable, with natural coordinated eyes, cheeks and mouth.

This remains FINE PIXEL ART matching the current hair and costume, deliberate economical colored clusters with crisp stepped edges. Do not replace the face with a high-resolution painted/airbrushed anime portrait or blurry smooth shading. It must be pleasing when the entire body is only 84 game pixels high; avoid oversized black eye shapes or loud red mouth marks. Keep the current natural warm colors and lighting. Do not impose a literal 4-pixel smile pattern.

Only facial skin/features and local cheek/chin contour may change. Everything outside the face remains as nearly identical as possible, including the forehead hairline and ears. One complete transparent full-body sprite only, no captions, scenery, ground or shadow.
processing: Exact generated PNG copy; original RGB sampled directly on the unchanged grid. No image rescaling, blur or recolor filters.
scope: Face refinement only: remove the block-shaped mouth, use smaller warm brown eyes with finer lids and brows, softer cheeks and chin, and a restrained smile. Retain gray blouse, berry bow, body scale, stance, scene and motion.

pixel_preview.comparison: Previous v30 at the same grid, scene and foot anchor; v31 facial cells have independently calibrated sampling.

acceptance: Two face passes reviewed at source, integer enlarged pixel card and actual game size. User aesthetic acceptance pending; no animation integration.
